query: What open-response signals predict low learning satisfaction?

per_column.name: interaction_collaboration_loss
per_column.rationale: A meaningful thematic axis (loss of peer interaction) that gives a genuine grouping variable for predicting low satisfaction. Grounding is mostly sound, but ED-0001 was labeled 'cannot_replicate_peer_discussion' when the text only mentions camera freezing and missing raising a hand quietly, not peer discussion loss -- a mild overreach.

per_column.name: subject_modality_fit
per_column.rationale: Captures whether hands-on/performance subjects translate to remote format, a strong analytical axis distinct from other columns. ED-0002's 'hands_on_labs_or_experiments_lost' is a defensible reading (labs over video), and silent rows correctly marked not_present.

per_column.name: instruction_quality
per_column.rationale: Instruction quality is a plausible driver of satisfaction and offers a distinct grouping axis. However labels are shaky: ED-0003 'teacher can't tell when she's lost' was tagged 'teacher_overwhelmed_or_disorganized' (an inference beyond the text), and ED-0005 'cannot get juniors to participate' was tagged 'teacher_unresponsive_to_student_needs' though the text describes student non-participation, not teacher unresponsiveness -- a mislabel.

per_column.name: engagement_sentiment
per_column.rationale: Multi-level engagement signal is more useful than a bare sentiment flag and relevant to satisfaction. But ED-0001 tagged 'bored_or_disengaged' when the text shows frustration/technical struggle, not boredom -- a misread of the affective state.

per_column.name: emotional_distress
per_column.rationale: Emotional distress is a plausible predictor of low satisfaction. Values are largely grounded, though ED-0001 'frustration_with_format_or_parent' is a stretch from 'I miss raising my hand.' Note this column is near-duplicated by emotional_distress_signals.

per_column.name: emotional_distress_signals
per_column.rationale: Essentially a restatement of 'emotional_distress' -- same value vocabulary and near-identical row values (identical on all 5 samples). This redundancy adds no new analytical leverage, so usefulness is very low despite comparable grounding.

judge.rationale: Most columns provide genuine, distinct thematic axes (collaboration loss, modality fit, instruction quality, engagement, distress) that are well-suited to predicting low learning satisfaction from open responses. The clear weakness is 'emotional_distress_signals', a near-exact duplicate of 'emotional_distress' that offers no new leverage. Grounding is generally sound with correct 'not_present' handling of silent rows, but several labels overreach the source text (e.g., inferring teacher disorganization, mislabeling frustration as boredom, or asserting peer-discussion loss where only technical issues are described), lowering groundedness modestly.
